panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (A, B). A: Panel A shows left great toe with panel-specific caption of divided nail and inflamed gutters supporting ingrown toenail, plus right great toe huge mass described as originating from lateral gutter secondary to chronic ingrown nail in disease-focused article. B: Close-up of right great toe tumor-like mass with 2cm ulcer; caption states mass originates from lateral gutter and article attributes huge hypertrophic scar to chronic ingrown nail, mapped to exuberant periungual hypergranulation as atypical variant.
